title: Design Reviews & Capstone
description: Study architecture decision records, security and privacy review boundaries, migration and rollout planning, and capstone: multi-tenant knowledge assistant. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Architecture decision records
lessons.description: Write a decision record with a measurable revisit trigger.
lessons.conceptOverview: Record the requirement, chosen option, alternatives and conditions that would trigger reconsideration. Decisions should explain trade-offs rather than merely naming technologies.
lessons.whyItMatters: Architecture decisions should document assumptions and trade-offs.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Record the requirement, chosen option, alternatives and conditions that would trigger reconsideration. Decisions should explain trade-offs rather than merely naming technologies.

sections.title: Concept
sections.content: Record the requirement, chosen option, alternatives and conditions that would trigger reconsideration. Decisions should explain trade-offs rather than merely naming technologies.

sections.title: Worked example
sections.content: A team chose a managed index for operational simplicity but later faces stricter locality requirements.

sections.title: Practice & verification
sections.content: Write a decision record with a measurable revisit trigger. Write down your reasoning and check it against the concept before continuing.

keyTakeaways: Architecture decisions should document assumptions and trade-offs.
commonMistakes: A technology name alone explains the design choice.

lessons.title: Security and privacy review boundaries
lessons.description: Draw the data flow and mark each access boundary.
lessons.conceptOverview: Map data and authority across components and identify where trust changes. Review logs, caches and third-party processing as well as the primary database.
lessons.whyItMatters: Security review must follow data through every derived artifact.

lessons.title: Migration and rollout planning
lessons.description: Plan a backward-compatible rollout and a deprecation check.
lessons.conceptOverview: Break migrations into compatible stages with validation and rollback. Separate data migration from traffic switching and define how old clients continue to operate.
lessons.whyItMatters: Schema migrations must account for active older clients.

keyTakeaways: Schema migrations must account for active older clients.

lessons.title: Capstone: multi-tenant knowledge assistant
lessons.description: Deliver a request sequence, capacity budget, isolation tests and failure responses.
lessons.conceptOverview: Design an evidence-grounded service with explicit SLOs, tenant isolation, ingestion freshness and overload behavior. Validate the design with traffic estimates and failure scenarios rather than a component diagram alone.
lessons.whyItMatters: A complete design explains operation under failure and load.
